d: Some wildlife encounters come with no warning, no easy escape and absolutely no guarantee of how things will unfold! Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, teams up with Neal James for a series of unpredictable animal rescue and capture missions. From dangerous snakes and stubborn turtles to raccoons and elusive mink, every call brings a different challenge. Whether it's snake catching, turtle catching or removing wild animals from unexpected places, these missions demand quick thinking and nerves of steel.
